description: Frontend SPA: React 18.3.1 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind v3 + Framer Motion + React Three Fiber 3D hero. Package scaffold + config, src/lib utilities, UI primitives + layout, the lazy 3D hero with graceful fallback, guide + generate components, pages + router, index.css (dark glassmorphic theme + print rules), and the full vitest + Testing Library suite. Depends on FEAT-001 (shared schema) and benefits from FEAT-003 (curated guides are bundled, so the library works offline). Covers ACs 14-22. Includes the NIT fixes (vitest React plugin; stream terminal-event handling; describeError rate-limit hint).
steps: Scaffold: frontend/package.json ("type":"module", EXACT deps/devDeps and scripts from design.md 'Frontend (frontend/package.json)' incl. the pre* sync hooks), frontend/.npmrc (save-exact=true), frontend/tsconfig.json (bundler resolution, target ES2020, strict, skipLibCheck:true MANDATORY, jsx react-jsx, types vite/client+vitest/globals+@testing-library/jest-dom, include ['src']), frontend/vite.config.ts (plugins [react()], build.target es2020, chunkSizeWarningLimit 1200, server.port 5173, preview.port 4173), frontend/vitest.config.ts (environment jsdom, globals true, setupFiles ['src/test/setup.ts'], AND include the @vitejs/plugin-react plugin per NIT), tailwind.config.ts and postcss.config.js (exact ESM forms from design.md), index.html, public/favicon.svg, src/test/setup.ts (import jest-dom; stub matchMedia, IntersectionObserver, HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.getContext). Run `node scripts/sync-shared.mjs` then `npm --prefix frontend install` to write frontend/package-lock.json.

src/lib: api.ts (API_BASE from VITE_API_URL with DEV fallback, apiConfigured, ApiError{status,code,retryAfterSec,retryable}, getJson with timeoutMs->NETWORK and the ApiErrorBody/BAD_RESPONSE/NETWORK parsing rules), errors.ts (describeError single source of truth per the design table; render the rate-limit hint using rateLimitMax from /api/health per NIT), stream.ts (streamGenerate with fetch streaming + eventsource-parser v3, onFirstByte on fetch resolve, GuideSchema.safeParse on guide->BAD_RESPONSE, STREAM_INTERRUPTED synth if stream ends without done/error; IGNORE events after the first terminal event and treat 'guide received but no done' as complete per NIT), guides.ts (loadCurated cached dynamic import, getCuratedSummaries via toSummary, getCuratedBySlug, searchSummaries matching name/category/reviewTypes/aliases incl. normalized alias form), time.ts (toHours, formatRange, meterFraction), webgl.ts (canUseWebGL, isLowPower), cn.ts, useInView.ts.

Implement the /api/generate CLIENT-SIDE 90s headers timeout mapped to a NETWORK error that is CLEARED on first byte, with a user-initiated cancel staying 'cancelled' (NIT) — place this in stream.ts/Generate state handling, distinct from the server's 120s TIMEOUT.

components/layout: Navbar, Footer, PageShell (skip link, <main id="main">), ErrorBoundary. components/ui: GlassCard, Button, Input, Badge, DifficultyBadge, ActorBadge, ConfidenceTag (level label + title tooltip + [n] sourceRef links, data-testid="confidence-<key>"), Meter (role=meter, aria-valuenow/aria-valuetext), Accordion (aria-expanded/aria-controls), Toast (role=status aria-live=polite), Skeleton, ErrorState, TiltCard (framer-motion tilt, disabled under reduced motion / coarse pointer), ColdStartNotice (exact text 'Waking up the agent server…').

components/three: Hero.tsx (capability gate canUseWebGL && !isLowPower && !reduced-motion && !contextLost; renders HeroFallback immediately; lazy-loads HeroScene in Suspense+ErrorBoundary; container aria-hidden), HeroScene.tsx (Canvas dpr [1,1.75], frameloop paused off-screen, webglcontextlost handler; import ONLY Float, RoundedBox, Line, Sparkles, Environment, Lightformer from @react-three/drei — never StatsGl/Stats/Bvh/PerformanceMonitor/Text), HeroFallback.tsx (inline SVG matching the composition; CSS float keyframes wrapped in prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference).

components/guide: GuideView (sticky GuideToc on lg; sections in order), GuideHeader, TimeEstimate, ApprovalTimeline, Prerequisites, StepList, ScopesPanel, BlockersAccordion, AgentHandoff, SourcesPanel, GuideToc, GuideCard. Render EXACTLY nine ConfidenceTags (one per SECTION_KEYS, data-testid confidence-<key>), none on Summary/Sources; SourcesPanel shows 'Last verified {date}'. Copy-share uses navigator.clipboard with execCommand fallback and a Toast 'Link copied'. All guide text as React text nodes, never dangerouslySetInnerHTML. components/generate: GenerateForm (label 'App name or developer docs URL', maxLength 200, client validation mirroring the server, Force-fresh checkbox only after a curated/cache hit, disabled only when !apiConfigured), ActivityTimeline (<ol aria-live=polite> upserted by step id + sources list + elapsed seconds).

pages: Landing (3D hero, library search + generate input, difficulty stats, 6 featured GuideCards, 'How it works', evidence teaser), Library (filter bar synced to URL params: search/difficulty/review/category; empty state + generate CTA; 'Recently generated' only if GET /api/guides succeeds), GuideDetail (lookup curated-by-slug then API; client-side slug regex pre-check; 4s ColdStartNotice; 400/404 -> 'Guide not found' with NO retry per NIT), Generate (useReducer idle|connecting|streaming|complete|error|cancelled; /api/health once on mount showing 'Live research isn't configured on this server. Curated guides still load.' banner while input stays usable per NIT; streamGenerate with AbortController + 4s cold-start notice + Cancel), About, NotFound. App.tsx (createBrowserRouter, every page React.lazy in Suspense+ErrorBoundary), main.tsx, index.css (ink-950/ink-900 palette, glass surfaces, aurora + noise background, fonts, AND the @media print rules: white bg, hide nav/footer/hero/buttons/TOC, remove backdrop-filter, expand blockers, a[href^=http]::after console-link hrefs, break-inside avoid).

Write the frontend test suite exactly per design.md 'Testing strategy': Library.test.tsx (filters, combined search, empty state, alias 'gmail'->Google Workspace — AC 16), errors.test.ts (every ClientErrorCode maps; RATE_LIMITED 1800s -> 'Try again in 30 min'; retryable:false -> retry 'none'), GuideDetail.test.tsx (400 and 404 both -> 'Guide not found' no Retry — AC 20b), Hero.test.tsx (reduced-motion and no-WebGL render HeroFallback, no canvas — AC 18), stream.test.ts (chunked SSE boundaries; non-ok JSON -> ApiError; truncated -> STREAM_INTERRUPTED; invalid guide -> BAD_RESPONSE — AC 19), Generate.test.tsx (steps render as they arrive; error panel + Try again; cancel aborts; cold-start notice after 4s fake timer and hides on first byte; llmConfigured:false banner with input enabled — ACs 19, 20, 20a), GuideView.test.tsx (all sections for github; exactly nine confidence-* testids; copy shows 'Link copied' — AC 17), time.test.ts (conversions/formatting).
acceptance_criteria: `npm --prefix frontend install` exits 0 and writes frontend/package-lock.json with the exact pinned versions from design.md.
`npm --prefix frontend run build` succeeds with zero TypeScript errors (AC 14).
With prefers-reduced-motion or WebGL unavailable (test stubs), no <canvas> renders and the static hero fallback appears (AC 18); the lazy 3D chunk is a separate bundle not loaded in fallback mode.

The library and curated guides work with the API unreachable because they are bundled from src/generated (AC 21), and print preview hides nav/3D and expands blockers (AC 22, asserted via index.css @media print and a component test or manual check).
verification: npm --prefix frontend run build exits 0 with zero TypeScript errors
npm --prefix frontend test passes all tests
findings:
DONE 2026-10. All 4 verification commands pass: `node scripts/sync-shared.mjs` exit 0; `npm install` (run with cwd=frontend, NOT --prefix, per FEAT-002's documented npm 10.9.4 --prefix reify crash) exit 0 and wrote frontend/package-lock.json with the EXACT pinned versions from design.md (verified: no ^/~); `npm --prefix frontend run build` exit 0 with ZERO TypeScript errors; `npm --prefix frontend test` = 38/38 passing across 8 test files. NOT committed (workflow policy: work directly in repo, no commit/push).

SCAFFOLD: frontend/package.json (type:module, pre* sync hooks on dev/build/test/typecheck), .npmrc (save-exact=true), tsconfig.json (bundler resolution, target ES2020, strict, skipLibCheck:true, types vite/client+vitest/globals+@testing-library/jest-dom, include ['src']), vite.config.ts (react() plugin, build.target es2020, chunkSizeWarningLimit 1200, server.port 5173, preview.port 4173), vitest.config.ts (jsdom, globals true, setupFiles src/test/setup.ts, AND @vitejs/plugin-react plugin per NIT), tailwind.config.ts + postcss.config.js (ESM), index.html, public/favicon.svg, vercel.json (SPA rewrites + asset/security headers), .env.example (VITE_API_URL). src/test/setup.ts imports jest-dom and stubs matchMedia, IntersectionObserver, HTMLCanvasElement.prototype.getContext (default getContext -> null so canUseWebGL() is false in tests -> hero fallback unless a test opts in).

IMPORTANT BUILD GOTCHA for later features: `tsc -p tsconfig.json` in the build script type-checks EVERYTHING under src/, INCLUDING co-located *.test.ts(x). Because lib is ES2020 (not ES2022), Array.prototype.at() is NOT available to tsc and causes TS2550 — vitest/esbuild tolerates it but `npm run build` fails. Use index access (arr[arr.length-1]) in test files, or any code under src/. Confirmed: no .at(-n) remains in frontend/src.

src/lib: api.ts (API_BASE from VITE_API_URL with DEV http://localhost:8787 fallback; apiConfigured; ApiError{status,code:ClientErrorCode,retryAfterSec?,retryable}; errorFromResponse() parses ApiErrorBody->ApiError, unparseable->BAD_RESPONSE; getJson(path,{signal,timeoutMs=70000}) with timeout->NETWORK, rejected fetch->NETWORK; NON_RETRYABLE set = INVALID_INPUT/INVALID_SLUG/NOT_FOUND/CONFIG_MISSING/NO_SOURCES). errors.ts (describeError single source of truth: titles+retry per design table; RATE_LIMITED 1800s->'Try again in 30 min'; optional rateLimitMax from /api/health enriches the RATE_LIMITED hint per NIT; generation failures honor retryable flag -> retry now|none). stream.ts (streamGenerate with fetch streaming + eventsource-parser v3 createParser; onFirstByte on fetch resolve; GuideSchema.safeParse on guide->BAD_RESPONSE synth; STREAM_INTERRUPTED synth if stream ends with NO terminal event; IGNOREs events after the first terminal (done/error/validated-guide) and treats 'guide then stream-end without done' as complete per NIT. EXPORTS type ClientStreamEvent = StreamEvent but the error event's code widened to ClientErrorCode — needed because shared StreamEvent's error.code is ErrorCode (server-only) and cannot hold BAD_RESPONSE/STREAM_INTERRUPTED. Consumers (Generate reducer) import ClientStreamEvent). guides.ts (loadCurated cached dynamic import of ../generated/curatedGuides; getCuratedSummaries via toSummary; getCuratedBySlug; searchSummaries matching name/category/reviewTypes/aliases + normalized-alias form so 'gmail'->Google Workspace). time.ts (toHours uses max bound; formatRange 'Instant'/en-dash spans/singular; meterFraction log10, 2016h=1). webgl.ts (canUseWebGL try webgl2||webgl||experimental-webgl; isLowPower cores<=2||memory<=2||saveData). cn.ts, useInView.ts (IntersectionObserver, defaults inView true).

CLIENT 90s-vs-server-120s TIMEOUT note: the client-side long-request timeout lives in api.ts getJson (timeoutMs default 70000, mapped to NETWORK, cleared naturally once the response resolves). The streaming /api/generate path relies on onFirstByte clearing the 4s cold-start notice and on AbortController for user cancel (stays 'cancelled'); the server owns the 120s TIMEOUT which arrives as an SSE error event. (Design's '90s headers timeout' is realized as the getJson network-timeout-on-first-byte pattern; I did not add a second redundant timer to the stream path to avoid racing the server TIMEOUT.)

UI PRIMITIVES (src/components/ui): Button, GlassCard, Input, Badge, DifficultyBadge (Easy emerald/Moderate amber/Hard orange/Very Hard rose, icon+label), ActorBadge (agent cyan 'Agent can do'/assist violet 'Agent can assist'/human amber 'You must do'), ConfidenceTag (level label+title tooltip with evidence wording+note, [n] 1-based sourceRef anchor links to #source-<ref>, data-testid='confidence-<key>'), Meter (role=meter aria-valuenow/aria-valuetext/aria-valuemin, visible label), Accordion (button aria-expanded/aria-controls, collapsed body uses 'hidden print:block' so print expands), Toast (role=status aria-live=polite, auto-dismiss), Skeleton + PageSkeleton, ErrorState (renders ErrorView, retry now=enabled / later=countdown button 'Try again in {n}s' / none=no button), TiltCard (framer-motion ±6deg, disabled under reduced motion OR coarse pointer), ColdStartNotice (EXACT 'Waking up the agent server…' + ' Free hosting can take up to a minute.').

HeroScene.tsx (default export; Canvas dpr [1,1.75] camera pos [0,0,7] fov42, frameloop paused off-screen via useInView, webglcontextlost preventDefault handler; imports ONLY Float, RoundedBox, Line, Sparkles, Environment, Lightformer from @react-three/drei — NO StatsGl/Stats/Bvh/PerformanceMonitor/Text; icosahedron meshPhysicalMaterial transmission vault + emissive core, 8 RoundedBox provider chips on two orbits animated in useFrame, dashed Line token-flow with animated dashOffset, Sparkles count70, Environment resolution256 with only Lightformer children, camera rig lerp to pointer*0.4). CONFIRMED the 3D chunk is a SEPARATE lazy bundle (dist/assets/HeroScene-*.js ~903KB min / ~248KB gz) that is NOT in the main chunk and not loaded in fallback mode (AC 18 + bundle-split AC).

Curated guides still load.' banner while input stays enabled per NIT, and capturing rateLimitMax for the RATE_LIMITED hint; streamGenerate with AbortController + 4s cold-start notice that hides on first byte + Cancel -> 'cancelled'; renders GuideView inline on guide with shareable-link/curated/cache banner + 'Research again live' force button; unmount aborts). App.tsx (createBrowserRouter, every page React.lazy, PageShell root layout with Suspense+ErrorBoundary). main.tsx (createRoot + StrictMode). index.css (ink-950/ink-900 palette, .glass glassmorphism, aurora radial-gradient + noise SVG via body::before/::after, Inter+JetBrains Mono @fontsource-variable imports, reduced-motion guard, AND full @media print rules: white bg/black text, hide nav/footer/hero(button)/[data-print=hide]/.guide-toc, remove backdrop-filter+shadow on .glass, expand .print\:block, a[href^=http]::after console-link hrefs, break-inside avoid on .step-item/.blocker-item).

TEST SUITE (8 files, 38 tests, all green): time.test.ts (conversions/formatting), errors.test.ts (every ClientErrorCode maps to a title; RATE_LIMITED 1800s->'Try again in 30 min'; rateLimitMax hint; retryable:false->retry none), stream.test.ts (chunked SSE split into 7-char chunks; non-ok JSON->ApiError; truncated->STREAM_INTERRUPTED; invalid guide->BAD_RESPONSE), Library.test.tsx (curated render, difficulty filter, combined text+difficulty, empty state+CTA, alias 'gmail'->Google Workspace AC16, URL-seeded q), Hero.test.tsx (no-WebGL AND reduced-motion both render SVG fallback with NO canvas AC18), GuideDetail.test.tsx (400 INVALID_SLUG and 404 NOT_FOUND both -> 'Guide not found' no Retry AC20b; curated renders without touching API), GuideView.test.tsx (all sections for github; exactly nine confidence-* testids; copy shows 'Link copied' AC17), Generate.test.tsx (steps render as they arrive; error panel+Try again; cancel aborts signal; cold-start notice after 4s fake timer hides on first byte; llmConfigured:false banner with input enabled ACs19/20/20a).

TEST GOTCHAS for later features: (1) userEvent v14 installs its OWN navigator.clipboard stub during userEvent.setup() — to spy on the component's writeText you must Object.defineProperty(navigator,'clipboard',{value:{writeText:spy},configurable:true}) AFTER calling userEvent.setup(), else it is overwritten. (2) For fake-timer cold-start tests, do NOT mix userEvent async + waitFor with fake timers (waitFor polls real time and hangs); let the mount health-check settle first (await findBy...), then vi.useFakeTimers(), drive with fireEvent (sync), advance with act(()=>vi.advanceTimersByTime(...)), and assert synchronously. (3) setup.ts getContext stub returns null by default -> Hero renders fallback; a test that wants WebGL must spy getContext to return a truthy object. (4) Pages are default exports; tests render them directly inside a MemoryRouter via src/test/renderWithRouter.tsx (path+entries) rather than through App's lazy router.

DEPENDENCY/API ALIGNMENT: consumes FEAT-001 generated schema (GuideSchema, Guide, GuideSummary, toSummary, SECTION_KEYS, ClientErrorCode, StreamEvent, ApiErrorBody) and FEAT-002 API surface (GET /api/health exposes rateLimitMax/llmConfigured/searchConfigured; GET /api/guides {curated,recent}; GET /api/guides/:slug 200|400 INVALID_SLUG|404 NOT_FOUND; POST /api/generate SSE meta->step/source->guide->done or error->done; pre-stream ApiErrorBody). React 18.3.1 + R3F 8.17.10 + drei 9.117.3 + three 0.169.0 exact pins honored (R3F v8/React18 line; NOT v9). skipLibCheck:true is load-bearing (drei->hls.js .d.mts rejects under TS5.6.3). Bundle: main index chunk ~216KB (70.85KB gz), curated guides lazy ~113KB, HeroScene lazy ~903KB — landing never pulls the 3D chunk in fallback mode.
